videos.overview: Pratibha, posing as Kunti, tries to mislead Chameli. However, before Chameli leaves, Kunti arrives! Will they be exposed?

videos.title: Kanhaiya And The Bahus' Plan
videos.overview: Kanhaiya and the bahus decide that Pratap, dressed up as Chameli, will meet Kunti. Will their plan work?

videos.title: Pratibha Tricks Kunti
videos.overview: With Pari, Panjiri and Kanhaiya's help, Pratibha sneaks out of the house. Disguised as Chameli, she meets Kunti. Later, Kunti pesters her to stay back and meet Pratibha!

videos.title: Kunti Invites Chameli
videos.overview: Pratibha misleads Kunti in Chameli's disguise. However, Kunti invites Chameli to the house once again. What will Kanhaiya and the bahus do this time?

videos.title: Kunti, Chameli Come Face-to-face
videos.overview: Kanhaiya and the Bahus' efforts to keep Kunti out of Chameli's sight fails. What will happen now?

videos.title: Kunti Wears a Moustache
videos.overview: Kunti prepares for her speech, while Pari helps Pratap select a fake moustache to fit for the role. The next day, everyone is shocked to find Kunti wearing a moustache.

videos.title: Kunti Devi Wants Revenge
videos.overview: Kunti vows to take the person who stuck the moustache on her face to Mundan Mandir. Kanhaiya and the bahus try to pull the moustache off her face.

videos.title: Pratibha's Smart Move
videos.overview: Pratibha controls the situation when Sarla and the others try to meet the woman with a moustache. Later, a civic authority personnel insists on meeting Kunti to get her signature on some documents.

videos.title: Kunti's New Look
videos.overview: As per Pratap's suggestion, Kunti dresses up like a man to meet Sarla. The bahus, Pratap and Kunti struggle to continue the drama. Kunti flirts with Sarla, leaving her family surprised.

videos.title: Bahus Give a Brilliant Solution
videos.overview: Kunti fails to find a solution to her problem and eventually decides to step out of the house. The bahus stop her and come up with a unique idea to solve Kunti's moustache problem.

videos.title: Prarthana, Panjiri Tell a Story
videos.overview: Prarthana and Panjiri depict the story of Adhik Maas to the family. Kanhaiya and his wives decide to follow the rituals of a puja. Later, Panjiri tells her family about a magical coconut.

videos.title: Kanhaiya Rebukes Khatru
videos.overview: Two thieves, disguised as saints, plan to make money by taking advantage of people's superstition. Prarthana tells her family about the rules of fasting during 'Adhik Maas'. Kanhaiya scolds Khatru for his stupidity.

videos.title: Kunti is Angry With Pratap
videos.overview: Kunti forbids Pratap from entering the house after he refuses to observe a fast. Pratap devises a strategy to change her mind. Meanwhile, two frauds plan to swindle Kunti.

videos.title: Kunti Becomes a Victim
videos.overview: The fraudsters, disguised as saints, try to trick Kunti and Panjiri. Their motive is to enter Kunti's house. Will they succeed in their plan?

videos.title: Kunti to Worship a Tomato!
videos.overview: Kunti invites the sages to Kunti Nivas without knowing their identity. While the bahus are reluctant, the sages tactfully persuade Kunti to worship a tomato.

videos.title: The Sages Mislead Kunti
videos.overview: Panjiri is about to chop the tomato which is supposed to be worshiped. The sages try to mislead Kunti and her family about the benefits of worshiping the tomato.

videos.title: A Plan Against Kunti's Family
videos.overview: The fraudsters prove to Kunti that they can make a double of anything that's offered to the Tomato God. Kunti decides to double her jewellery and money. Will the fraudsters succeed?

videos.title: Shocking News For Kanhaiya
videos.overview: Kunti's family catches hold of the impostors, who were trying to rob them in the name of God. A notice from the government office traumatizes Kanhaiya.

videos.title: Why is Prarthana Happy?
videos.overview: Kanhaiya and his wives worry about the money to pay the revenue department to save their shop. Later, Prarthana receives a good news that could benefit Kanhaiya.

videos.title: Kunti to Become a Crorepati
videos.overview: Kunti and Kanhaiya are excited as a lawyer visits them with a cheque of two crore rupees. But, Kunti's excitement is short-lived as she learns about the lawyer's terms and conditions.

videos.title: Kunti's Risky Plan
videos.overview: In order to get the money, Kunti convinces Pari, Prarthana, Panjiri and Prema to act like housemaids in front of the lawyer.

videos.title: Kanhaiya And Pratibha's Drama
videos.overview: Pratibha and Kanhaiya get over romantic in front of the lawyers to prove that they are an ideal couple. Kunti gets annoyed seeing the lawyers ogling at Prarthana and Panjiri.

videos.title: Kunti's Plan At Stake
videos.overview: Kunti and her family try to convince the lawyers that Pratibha is the only wife of Kanhaiya. But, Sarla arrives at the scene and reveals that he has five wives. Can Kunti handle the situation?

videos.title: Kanhaiya's Doubtful Behaviour
videos.overview: The lawyer and his associate keep an eye on Kanhaiya, Pratibha and the others. Unaware of the truth, they get doubtful, seeing Kanhaiya's behaviour with the maids. Will they find out the truth?

videos.title: Kunti's Plan Backfires?
videos.overview: Sharma and his assistant demand Kunti to get them married to Panjiri and Prarthana if she wants the cheque for 2 crore rupees! What will Kunti do now?

videos.title: Kanhaiya Reveals The Truth
videos.overview: Left with no option, Kanhaiya tells the lawyer that he has five wives. Seeing the bahus' love for each other, the lawyer considers Kanhaiya to be a happily married guy. Will he give Kanhaiya the money?

videos.title: Kunti Feels Insecure
videos.overview: Sarla provokes Kunti against her bahus. Kunti feels insecure, thinking that her bahus will neglect her. She asks the bahus to ardently follow her instructions.

videos.title: Kunti's Clever Strategy
videos.overview: Kunti fears that her bahus will dominate her. She determines to tackle this situation by breaking the unity among her bahus and plans to pit Prema against Pratibha.

videos.title: Prema, Pratibha At Loggerheads
videos.overview: Kunti rejoices as Prema and Pratibha get into a fight. Later, she aims to break the bond between two of her other daughters-in-law. Who are they?

videos.title: Kunti's Ill-intention
videos.overview: Kunti tries to create a rift between Panjiri and Pari. Kanhaiya is surprised to notice Pratibha and Prema's behaviour towards each other.

videos.title: Kunti's Plan Against The Bahus
videos.overview: Kunti tries to create a rift between Panjiri and Pari. She tells Pari not to talk to anyone and tries to create a distance between Pratibha and Panjiri with Kusum and Pratap's help.

videos.title: Kunti's Plan is Working
videos.overview: After successfully creating misunderstandings between Panjiri and Pratibha, Kunti targets Prarthana and Prema. She rejoices as her plan is working fine.

videos.title: Kanhaiya is In a Dilemma
videos.overview: Kanhaiya is disturbed thinking about the differences among his wives. Kunti tries to provoke him against the bahus.

videos.title: Kanhaiya is Frustrated
videos.overview: Kanhaiya’s wives quarrel with each other over stitching his shirt buttons. He tries to make Kunti realise her folly. Meanwhile, Pratibha hurts her finger. Will the other bahus come to her aid?

videos.title: Kanhaiya And His Wives Team Up
videos.overview: Kanhaiya and his wives decide to clarify Kunti's misconceptions. They implement a plan to convey her that they love her and have no intentions of dominating her.

videos.title: Kunti, The Mind Reader
videos.overview: Kunti believes that she is a psychic and decides to read everyone's mind in the house. Little does Kunti know that Kanhaiya and his wives are messing with her mind.

videos.title: Kunti Apologises to Her Bahus
videos.overview: Kunti regrets creating misunderstandings among her bahus. She confesses her misdeed and apologises to them.

videos.title: A Shock For Panjiri
videos.overview: Kunti and the bahus prepare for the social welfare event about drug addiction. Later, Panjiri is shocked to find cigarettes in Kanhaiya's pocket.

videos.title: Kanhaiya Smokes?
videos.overview: Kanhaiya's wives decide to find out if Kanhaiya smokes and make him quit this addiction. Panjiri and Pratibha go to his shop to question him about the same.

videos.title: Kanhaiya is Accused
videos.overview: Prema hides the pack of cigarettes in the grocery bag. Kunti insists on seeing the contents of the bag. Meanwhile, Panjiri and Pratibha accuse Kanhaiya of being a smoker.

videos.title: Kunti Trusts Kanhaiya
videos.overview: Panjiri and Pratibha continue to assume that Kanhaiya is addicted to smoking. Kunti gets a picture of Kanhaiya printed on her de-addiction campaign posters claiming that he has no bad habits.

videos.title: Kanhaiya Cigarette Peeta Hai!
videos.overview: Kanhaiya berates his friend for his smoking habit and educates him to quit smoking. Kanhaiya's wives mistake him to be a smoker himself. Where will this confusion lead them?

videos.title: Prema, Panjiri have a Plan
videos.overview: Panjiri, Prema and the others decide to catch Kanhaiya red-handed while he smokes. Overhearing Kanhaiya's conversation with his friend, they assume that he is going out for a smoke.

videos.title: A Huge Disappointment For Kunti
videos.overview: Kanhaiya's wives spy on him, assuming that he went out to smoke. Kunti faints as she thinks that Kanhaiya smokes and consumes alcohol!

videos.title: Kunti Worries About Kanhaiya
videos.overview: Kunti fears the consequences of confronting Kanhaiya about his smoking habit. Pratap convinces Kanhaiya to play the roll of a drunkard. Kunti and Panjiri panic after they overhear Kanhaiya's conversation with Khatru.

videos.title: Pratibha Discloses The Truth
videos.overview: Kunti sets out to speak about Kanhaiya's smoking addiction in her speech. Meanwhile, Pratibha tells the other bahus that Kanhaiya is neither a drunkard nor is he addicted to smoking.

videos.title: Kunti Realises Her Folly
videos.overview: Kunti realises her folly and apologises to Kanhaiya after Kamal tells everyone that Kanhaiya helped him quit his smoking habit. Later, Pratibha, Prema and Kunti are unable to find Kanhaiya!

videos.title: Kunti Worships Lord Shiva
videos.overview: Kunti feels distressed after hearing Kanhaiya's problem with the dance rehearsals. She worships Lord Shiva to grant her son a boon.

videos.title: Kanhaiya Gets Special Powers
videos.overview: Kanhaiya receives a special power after he survives an electric shock. Later, his wives are exhausted after they practice dance with him for the Sangeet ceremony while Kanhaiya remains active!

videos.title: Pratap Gets an Electric Shock
videos.overview: Over the breakfast, Pratap gets an electric shock when he accidentally touches Kanhaiya. The situation worsens when one of Kanhaiya’s customers receives an electric shock.

videos.title: Kanhaiya has Superpowers!
videos.overview: Kanhaiya's wives learn that he has some superpowers. They prevent Kunti from hugging Kanhaiya while Pratibha proves that he is 'Bijli Man'.

videos.title: Kanhaiya to Stay In His Shop
videos.overview: Khatru refuses to help Kanhaiya when he seeks his help regarding his peculiar problem. He suffers an electric shock when he hugs Kanhaiya. Later, Kanhaiya decides to stay in his shop.

videos.title: Kanhaiya's Troublesome Powers
videos.overview: The news about Kanhaiya being the Bijli Man goes viral. Kunti and Pratibha get tensed on learning that Vimala's son's marriage got called off.

videos.title: Power House, Kanhaiya
videos.overview: When the power goes off in Kanhaiya’s house, he helps his wives and his mother in different ways using his powers. Later, Kanhaiya saves a man from getting robbed by electrocuting the thugs.

videos.title: Kunti Falls Unconscious!
videos.overview: Kunti decides to worship Lord Shiv to help Kanhaiya from the electrifying scenario. Everyone is shocked as Kunti falls unconscious. The doctor confirms Kunti has kicked the bucket!

videos.title: Kanhaiya's Life is In Danger
videos.overview: A sage warns Kanhaiya that a naagin will hunt him down within nine days to take her revenge. What has Kanhaiya done?

videos.title: Kanhaiya In a Weird Situation
videos.overview: Chaurasiya informs Kunti that to counter the nagin's wrath, Kanhaiya has to pretend to be a snake for a day. On the other end, the nagin keeps an eye on Kanhaiya.

videos.title: A Naagin In Kunti Nivas
videos.overview: A naagin visits Kunti Nivas in the disguise of Naina, a salesgirl. Panjiri suspects that Naina is a naagin. Kanhaiya drinks milk like a snake. Later, Panjiri frets when she enters Kanhaiya's room. Why?

videos.title: Kanhaiya Turns Into a Coconut?
videos.overview: Naagin rests on a snoozing Kanhaiya and fizzles as his family members watch in horror. Later, Panjiri breaks into tears as she believes Kanhaiya has turned into a coconut.

videos.title: A Snake Around Kanhaiya's Neck
videos.overview: Khatru gets scared when he notices a snake around Kanhaiyas neck. Later, Naagin visits Kanhaiyas house. But, why?

videos.title: Pratap, The Scapegoat
videos.overview: Pratap fears for his life as Kanhaiya's wives bait him to catch the naagin. Panjiri is alarmed as she witnesses Kunti hissing in distress. Has naagin taken the form of Kunti?

videos.title: Naagin Confronts Kanhaiya
videos.overview: Panjiri, Prema and Pratibha suspect that Kunti is a naagin and try to clarify their doubts about the same. Meanwhile, at Kanhaiya's shop, a naagin, thirsty for revenge, confronts him.

videos.title: Kunti Gives a Chance to Pratap
videos.overview: Kunti compels Pratap to work as a peon when he asks her for money. However, on Kanhaiya's insistence, she decides otherwise and asks him to leave the house if he fails to repay her within two days.

videos.title: A Shock Awaits Kunti
videos.overview: Kunti is determined to oust Pratap if he fails to repay her. However, Pratap makes a shocking claim when Kunti demands the money he had borrowed from her.

videos.title: Pratap's Move Against Kunti
videos.overview: Kunti tells everyone that she did not receive any money from Pratap and decides to expose him. Meanwhile, Pratap comes up with a clever plan to foil her attempts.

videos.title: Kunti's Memory Loss
videos.overview: Kunti is shocked when Pratap tries to prove that she is having a short-term memory loss. Kanhaiya and his wives are worried about Kunti's situation. Will Kunti be able to prove Pratap wrong?

videos.title: Pratap Targets Kunti
videos.overview: Pratap misleads Kunti into believing that there will be a flood. Later, he tricks Prarthana and Panjiri into believing that Kunti is extremely absent-minded.

videos.title: Shock Treatment For Kunti!
videos.overview: Pratap stops the doctor from taking Kunti to the mental hospital. He feels hassled as the doctor decides to subject Kunti to shock treatment to revive her memory! What will Pratap do now?

videos.title: Panjiri In Trouble!
videos.overview: Kanhaiya's wives are scared to find out that Muhnochwa is terrorising their city. Kanhaiya is reluctant to believe that Muhnochwa exists. Meanwhile, Muhnochwa tries to attack Panjiri!

videos.title: Khatru Ki Jaan Khatre Mein
videos.overview: Kanhaiya and his family members are alarmed as an unknown creature attacks Khatru. Kunti is shocked to learn the reason behind the creature's visit.

videos.title: What will Ram Prasad do Now?
videos.overview: The police inform Kunti that Ram Prasad will be felicitated with a bravery award on Independence Day for facing the dangerous creature. Will he become the creature's next target?

videos.title: Kanhaiya to Nab Muhnochwa
videos.overview: Kunti fears that Muhnochwa will attack her. Kanhaiya and others assure Kunti that they will protect her. Later, Kanhaiya devises a plan to nab Muhnochwa.

videos.title: The Bahus Protect Kunti
videos.overview: Kanhaiya and family panic on noticing a threatening message stating that Muhnochwa will return to target Kunti. The bahus determine to protect Kunti. Will they be successful?

videos.title: Kunti's Altered Identity
videos.overview: The evil severed hand attacks Pratap who disguises himself as Kunti. Later, Kunti's daughters-in-law come up with a plan to save her, with a new identity.

videos.title: Kunti Provokes Muhnochwa
videos.overview: Learning that Muhnochwa is attacking others in his attempt to find Kunti, she decides to come out in the open. She gives a press statement challenging him to come to Kunti Nivas!

videos.title: Kunti And Family Fight Back!
videos.overview: Kunti and her family decide to fight back against the severed hand. Everyone's fear turns into joy when a special guest visits their house.

videos.title: Ravi Dubey Visits Kunti Nivas
videos.overview: Ravi Dubey visits Kunti Nivas to promote his show, Sabse Smart Kaun? He puts Kanhaiya and his family's wit to test. Later, he tries to solve the mystery of Muhnochwa.

videos.title: Kanhaiya Solves The Mystery
videos.overview: Kanhaiya and his family solve the mystery of the severed hand with the help of Ravi Dubey. Later, Kanhaiya is shocked when Kusum demands an expensive gift on the occasion of Rakshabandhan.

videos.title: Kanhaiya is Threatened
videos.overview: Kanhaiya gets a threat note, asking him to stop the Rakshabandhan sari discount sale in his shop. Who is threatening Kanhaiya?

videos.title: Kusum Gets Abducted
videos.overview: The situation gets scary for Kunti and her family members when they receive too many threatening notes. Next morning, Kusum gets abducted from her doorstep.

videos.title: Kanhaiya has a Plan
videos.overview: Kanhaiya comes up with a plan to teach Kusum a lesson after he learns that she planned her own kidnapping just to get a new phone.

videos.title: Devaki, Kanhaiya's Real Mother?
videos.overview: Kanhaiya’s wives find it difficult to get a haircut for him as he starts laughing at the sounds of the scissors. Meanwhile, Kunti meets Kanhaiya’s real mother, Devaki.

videos.title: Kanhaiya Learns The Truth
videos.overview: Kanhaiya gets upset when he learns that he is Kunti’s adopted child. Meanwhile, Devaki tells Kunti that she wants to meet him. Will Kunti oblige her?

videos.title: Kunti Disappoints Kanhaiya?
videos.overview: Kunti asks Devaki to meet Kanhaiya on Krishna Janmashtami. Kanhaiya is upset on learning that Kunti doesn’t remember any of his childhood incidents. Later, he decides to ask Kunti about his biological parents.

videos.title: Shocking News For Kanhaiya
videos.overview: Kanhaiya is utterly shocked as he eavesdrops on Kunti's conversation and learns that he's Kunti's adopted son. Who is Kanhaiya's real mother?

videos.title: Kunti to Send Kanhaiya Away
videos.overview: Kunti decides to send Kanhaiya to Hoshangabad for good. Kanhaiya and his wives are tensed as they learn about it. Will Kanhaiya abide by Kunti's words?

videos.title: Kanhaiya Feels Relieved
videos.overview: Kunti clarifies Kanhaiya and her Bahus misunderstanding regarding Devaki. Kanhaiya is relieved to learn that Kunti is only his biological mother and not Devaki. Later, Kunti buys silver bangles for her Bahus.

videos.title: Kunti Wants Compensation
videos.overview: Kunti seeks compensation from Lord Shiva for misunderstanding her and giving her five bahus. She asks him to grant her five shops. Later, Kunti is hassled as Panjiri refuses to recognise her!

videos.title: Panjiri Forgets Kunti, Kanhaiya
videos.overview: Panjiri refuses to recognise anyone from Kanhaiya's family except Prarthana. Lord Shiv tells Kunti that he will let Kanhaiya have only one wife as he owns a single shop. What will Kunti do now?

videos.title: Kunti is In Big Trouble
videos.overview: Kunti worries about the consequences of her allegations and thinks twice before talking to Kanhaiya's wives. After Panjiri's memory loss, another Bahu falls prey to Kunti's words.

videos.title: Pratibha to Get Married Again?
videos.overview: Kunti, Kanhaiya and Pratap go to Pratibha's home to bring her back. They get hassled on learning that Pratibha's parents are planning to get her married to someone else!

videos.title: Prarthana, Panjiri Take a Stand
videos.overview: Pratap talks to Pratibha's parents against getting her married again. After Kunti scolds Prarthana, she refuses to recognise her and Kanhaiya. Panjiri and Prarthana go away from Kanhaiya's house with their uncle.

videos.title: Kunti Prays to Lord Shiv
videos.overview: Kunti requests Lord Shiv to let all her Bahus stay with her as she wishes to celebrate Teej with them. Kanhaiya learns that Panjiri and Prarthana's parents are planning to get them married. What will he do now?

videos.title: Pari Leaves Kunti Nivas
videos.overview: After Kunti scolds Pari, she forgets that she is married to Kanhaiya. Paying no heed to Kunti's request, she leaves Kunti Nivas with her mother.

videos.title: Will Lord Shiva Agree?
videos.overview: Kunti asks Lord Shiva to get Kanhaiya’s wives back into his life. Will Lord Shiva listen to Kunti's plea?

videos.title: Kunti Dotes On Her Bahus
videos.overview: Kunti is elated to see her five Bahus celebrating the Teej festival. Pari has a disturbing dream. Mistaking a scorpion for ginger, Panjiri holds it in her hand!

videos.title: Kunti Stung By a Scorpion?
videos.overview: Kunti’s bahus fret, assuming that a scorpion has stung her. As part of the treatment, they stop her from falling asleep. However, why is Kanhaiya feeling uneasy?

videos.title: Kunti, Bahus Play Antakshari
videos.overview: Kanhaiya is unable to believe that a scorpion stung him. Kunti's Bahus challenge her to win against them in a game of antakshari to keep her awake the entire night.

videos.title: Antakshari At Kunti's House
videos.overview: Kunti, Kanhaiya and his wives play antakshari to keep Kunti awake. The next morning, Kanhaiya and the bahus come up with a unique idea to prevent Kunti from sleeping.

videos.title: Kanhaiya is Not Fine
videos.overview: While Kanhaiya is unwell, Pratibha and the others assume that he is pretending according to their plan to prevent Kunti from falling asleep!

videos.title: Kunti, Bahus Pray For Kanhaiya
videos.overview: The effect of poison takes a toll on Kanhaiya and he collapses. Kunti and his wives learn that he is stung by a scorpion and pray fervently for his recovery.

videos.title: Kanhaiya's Plans For Ganesh Utsav
videos.overview: Kunti and Kanhaiya, with their neighbours, plan to celebrate Ganesh Mahotsav. Kunti intends to make Sarla feel jealous.

videos.title: Pratap Commits a Blunder
videos.overview: Pratap mistakes that the box containing Kunti’s expensive ornament has prasad in it and offers it to Lord Ganesh at the Ganesh Mahotsav puja!

videos.title: A New Problem For Kunti
videos.overview: Kunti worries about losing a costly jewellery after offering it to Lord Ganesh during the festival. Few burglars decide to loot the valuables. Will Kunti get back her jewellery?

videos.title: Kunti Seeks a Solution
videos.overview: Kanhaiya sets out to buy jewellery for Kunti. Meanwhile, Kunti seeks a solution from Lord Shiv for her problem. She and her bahus are upset to learn about the stolen offerings.

videos.title: Kunti Feels Relieved
videos.overview: Kunti heaves a sigh of relief as she finds her expensive ornament. Later, she compels a reluctant Kanhaiya and Pratibha to send her to Banaras.

videos.title: Kunti to Visit Banaras
videos.overview: Kunti leaves for Banaras. Later, Kanhaiya and his family worry about her after they contact someone in Banaras.

videos.title: Kunti is Missing!
videos.overview: Kanhaiya and his wives are hassled as they are unable to track Kunti's whereabouts after she goes to Banaras. Kanhaiya seeks help from the police to find her.

videos.title: Kunti is Abducted!
videos.overview: Panjiri, Pratibha and Pari search for Kunti. Meanwhile, Kanhaiya panics when Kunti’s abductors call him to demand a ransom.

videos.title: The Police Suspect Pratap
videos.overview: The police suspect that Pratap has abducted Kunti. The fake kidnappers plan to collect ransom from Kanhaiya and inform him that Kunti is in their captivity!

videos.title: Kanhaiya Spots Kunti
videos.overview: Kanhaiya sets out to pay the ransom. Seeing Kunti, he refuses to pay the fake abductors but, they try to take away the money.

videos.title: Pratibha Misleads Her Uncle
videos.overview: Pratibha tries to mislead her uncle that she is still unmarried and runs an old age home. She and the others make a plan to achieve this.

videos.title: Pratibha is In a Soup!
videos.overview: Prarthana and the others help Pratibha mislead her uncle. Pratibha frets when her uncle extends his stay in her house.

videos.title: Kanhaiya, a Thief?
videos.overview: Kanhaiya panics when Kunti insists that she wants to return home immediately. Later, Pratibha's uncle, Tejpal suspects Kanhaiya to be a thief!

videos.title: Kunti Learns Pratibha's Plan?
videos.overview: Pratibha's plan is at risk as Kunti returns home. Kunti confronts Tejpal when she sees him at her house!

videos.title: Panjiri And Team Help Kanhaiya
videos.overview: After Tejpal suspects Kanhaiya's identity, Panjiri and the others set up a tea stall for Kanhaiya and help him mislead Tejpal that he supplies tea.

videos.title: Pratibha Confesses to Tejpal
videos.overview: Pratibha defends Kanhaiya when Tejpal accuses him of theft. She also reveals to him that Kanhaiya is her husband!

videos.title: Kanhaiya Faces Business Issues
videos.overview: Kanhaiya is hassled as he faces loss in his business. Kunti worries about him. Pratap's problems get resolved after taking a suggestion from a baba.

videos.title: Kanhaiya Pushed to The Wall
videos.overview: Kunti compels Kanhaiya to marry a buffalo as per a pandit's suggestion. Will this resolve Kanhaiya's business problems?

videos.title: Kanhaiya to Marry a Buffalo
videos.overview: Kunti tries her best to convince Kanhaiya to get married to a buffalo. She also takes a look at a buffalo named Chameli to be Kanhaiya's bride.

videos.title: Kunti Search For a Buffalo
videos.overview: Kunti asks one of her relatives to get his buffalo married to Kanhaiya. However, he mistakes that she wants to get his daughter married to Kanhaiya.

videos.title: Kanhaiya to Marry Pushpa!
videos.overview: Kunti gets the proposal of Pushpa, the buffalo, fixed for Kanhaiya. Prema comes up with an idea to identify Pushpa when she goes missing.

videos.title: Kanhaiya to Marry Pushpa!
videos.overview: Kunti gets the proposal of Pushpa, the buffalo, fixed for Kanhaiya. Prema comes up with an idea to identify Pushpa when she goes missing.

videos.title: Kanhaiya, Pratibha Team Up
videos.overview: Kanhaiya, Pratibha and Chaurasiya expose the fake Baba's misdeed and stop Kunti from getting Kanhaiya married to Pushpa.

videos.title: Kunti is Angry At Her Bahus
videos.overview: After learning about the misuse of the house funds, Kunti accuses her bahus of stealing the money. She vows to find the thief and oust her.

videos.title: Kunti Suspects Panjiri
videos.overview: Kunti suspects that Panjiri is misleading her and stealing money from the house expenses. She determines to catch her red-handed.

videos.title: Kunti's Plan Backfires
videos.overview: Kunti asks Kusum to create a situation so that Panjiri's lies will get revealed. But her plan backfires.
